title: Purple Account at a glance
summary: “Purple Account at a glance” lists travel and everyday banking terms: 0% foreign transaction fee, $0.00 foreign ATM withdrawal fee (operator fees may still apply), up to $30/month global ATM fee rebates, and a 0.5% currency conversion markup over the interbank rate. It also notes a multi-currency wallet (up to 30 currencies), 6 complimentary airport lounge visits/year, $0 domestic incoming wire fee, $5,000/day mobile check deposit limit, direct deposits up to 2 days early, and APY boosts of +0.3% (Platinum Plus Savings) or +0.1% (Gold Savings).
faqs: Does the Purple Account charge foreign transaction fees or foreign ATM withdrawal fees?
What is the currency conversion markup and how is it calculated vs the interbank rate?
How much are the global ATM fee rebates, and are there any conditions/limits?
What multi-currency wallet support is included (number of currencies)?
What are the mobile check deposit daily limits and the direct deposit timing feature?
Are domestic incoming wire transfers free, and what lounge access and APY boosts are included?
